indicator_name: 1-year yield differential: KZ government securities (KASE curve) minus US Treasuries
description: Дифференциал доходностей 1 год: ГЦБ РК (кривая KASE) минус UST
methodology: Percentage points, monthly means: KASE zero-coupon government securities yield at 1 year (GS_YIELD_1Y) minus the 1-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (FRED GS1), from 2019-11. Zero-coupon vs par basis -- a few basis points at 1 year.
